name: ir_get_latest_earnings
description:
The most recent earnings material (earnings presentation or release) of a supported company, from its investor relations site.
Returns {ticker, latest_earnings: {title, url, type, year, quarter, date, description, ticker, is_pdf, context}, previous_earnings: [up to 4 earlier documents], success}, or latest_earnings null with a message when nothing is found.
Inputs (* required): ticker* (string, stock symbol such as AAPL or MSFT; case-insensitive).
Scrapes the company's IR site; falls back to SEC EDGAR filings when that finds nothing and a CIK is known. Only tickers in SAJHA's built-in company list work (ir_list_supported_companies); others fail with 'not supported'. For reported figures rather than documents, the SEC tools (e.g. edgar_company_concept) are an alternative.
Example: {"ticker": "MSFT"}
